purpose: Teach: 子猫/じゃがいも/コケ/煮物/献立/阪神タイガース/作画/生放送

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、地域文化、子猫を題材にした絵本、紹介していますね。
lines.en: Sakura, I see you've included a picture book with kittens as the theme for your local culture project.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging opening. Steady eye contact. Recognition in the voice — noticing the care in the work. Gentle pace, present.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。じゃがいもの煮物など郷土料理も、章にしました。
lines.en: Yes. I also made a whole chapter on regional dishes — potato simmered in different ways, things like that.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly eager to explain. Speaking clearly, wanting her to understand the depth of what she found. Small pause before 'things like that' — still discovering.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: コケや苔の文化、日本庭園との関連、丁寧ですね。
lines.en: The way you connected moss culture to Japanese gardens — that's really thoughtful work.
lines.style: Genuinely struck. Not performing surprise — real noticing. Slow, deliberate delivery. Slight lean forward in attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 郷土の献立、地域ごとに違いがあって、面白いです。
lines.en: Each region has its own signature dishes, and they're all so different. It was really interesting to find that out.
lines.style: Conversational, warming up. Less formal now — sharing the actual discovery. Small smile in the voice. Pace relaxing slightly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: プロ野球、阪神タイガースのファン文化、別章でしたね。
lines.en: And you dedicated a whole section to Hanshin Tigers fan culture in professional baseball. That's a nice tangent.
lines.style: Reflective, gently amused. Not questioning the choice — validating it. Slight lift at the end, inviting her perspective on the connection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 漫画作画の歴史、流派ごとの違い、調べました。
lines.en: I noticed you researched manga art history too — how different schools approach it differently.
lines.style: Observant, acknowledging the breadth. No judgment. Pace steady. The tone of someone who sees how much ground she covered.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地上波と生放送、文化メディアの章、興味深いですね。
lines.en: Your chapter on broadcast media versus live performance and how they've shaped culture — that's a really compelling angle.
lines.style: Satisfied, intellectual interest evident. Clear delivery on 'compelling.' The genuine pleasure of seeing a student think sideways. Ending on slight rise of invitation for more.
